title: UXID conformance case: decode
description: One line of decode.json: a string and what a decoder reads from it. The delimiter is `_`. The random field is not read back on decode.

id.description: Stable case id, `decode/` and a slug.

prefix.description: Everything before the last delimiter; null when there is no delimiter.

size.description: The size the body length gives.

compact.description: Whether the body length is a compact one.

deterministic.description: Whether the body starts with the marker `z` or `Z`.

time.description: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch; null for a deterministic body. A compact time depends on the decoder's clock (see the README).
